# Cloudvora.pk

> Cloudvora is a digital solutions agency based in Dera Ghazi Khan, Pakistan. We build custom websites, POS and business software for restaurants, clinics, real estate and local brands in Pakistan and worldwide.

## Services
- Custom website development
- Business software and restaurant POS systems
- Website redesign and improvements
- Custom chatbots (coming soon)
